title: Negative-binomial ensemble filtering for discrete-time Hawkes network reconstruction
summary: We develop a sequential ensemble filter for reconstructing directed excitation networks from overdispersed multivariate counts observed on a regular time grid. The data-generating model is a discrete-time negative-binomial Hawkes process, for which we prove exact first- and second-moment stability conditions and derive a row-wise sufficient condition. The filter learns the network and the dispersion online, and a row-composition parameter forecast keeps enough ensemble variation to respond to structural change.
